label: invented example

columns_or_fields.name: FLAG
columns_or_fields.meaning: Bit flags, zero here for an unpaired forward alignment.

columns_or_fields.name: MAPQ
columns_or_fields.meaning: Mapping quality, here an invented score of 60.

columns_or_fields.name: CIGAR
columns_or_fields.meaning: Operations consuming read or reference bases: M is aligned bases and I is a read insertion.

columns_or_fields.name: RNEXT
columns_or_fields.meaning: Mate reference name, * because these reads are unpaired.

columns_or_fields.name: PNEXT
columns_or_fields.meaning: Mate position, zero because no mate is supplied.

columns_or_fields.name: TLEN
columns_or_fields.meaning: Template length, zero because these reads are unpaired.

header_notes: @HD declares version and sort order, @SQ names toy1 and its length, and @CO contains a comment.
The second read has 4M1I5M: ten read bases aligned across nine reference bases.
